Title: 01 HEROES
Six large full body characters in 3 columns x2 rows. Top Crown: MARSHAL muscular veteran hammer shield blue cape crown; PATHFINDER lean hooded veteran ranger with longbow, green cloak blue sash and quiver, distinct from Huntress; SAGE older bearded fire wizard purple robes angular wide hat orange crystal staff. Bottom Thornwild: THORN WARDEN huge antler-helmet bark-armored champion thorn maul wooden shield; HUNTRESS agile red-haired female leaf-cloaked recurved-bow archer; GROVE SPEAKER elderly druid in layered leaf robes leafy crown, branching staff holding green seed orb. Distinct body types and facial personalities. Each cell main 3/4 full-body pose and smaller rear-view silhouette with cloak/quiver details. No weapons cropped.
